title: How To ACTUALLY Get a Job in 2026
description:
Most people think landing a job in 2026 means applying more and hoping someone notices. In this market, that mindset keeps you stuck. In this video I break down the three shifts my students make to stop chasing jobs and start creating offers, with real examples of candidates who went from zero interviews to JP Morgan and Citadel without elite degrees or insider connections.

IN THIS VIDEO:
0:00 Why applying more is broken
0:57 Step 1: Own your personal story
2:42 Step 2: LATR networking (List, Ask, Track, Repeat)
4:06 Tim's JP Morgan story
4:27 Step 3: Walk into interviews with conviction
5:30 Recap
6:06 What to do next

ABOUT ME:
I dropped out of university at 19 to build recruitment software and ATS systems used by hiring teams. For years I spoke to hundreds of hiring managers and recruiters every day, learning exactly how candidates get filtered, shortlisted, and hired from the inside. I started coaching friends through their job search using what I'd seen, then raised investment, built a software company, and hired my own team. I've seen hiring from every angle.

Today I help job seekers land offers faster using a proven 3-step system. I've coached hundreds of candidates into roles at firms like JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, EY, and PwC and many more.
